question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Raise an alarm

options.text: set the alarm clock to wake one up

solution:
The correct answer is: **warn of a dangerous situation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom '**Raise an alarm**' is an expression used to make people understand the danger of something.

 
 
• Example- *A local doctor was the first to **raise the alarm__** about this latest virus.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Raise an alarm' is 'warn of a dangerous situation.'

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
